key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence enabled stronger perovskite reasoning and guided a contact-material choice that outperformed the expert-preferred alternative.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI can support perovskite device optimization, with the selected contact delivering 27.05% efficiency and 96.74% efficiency retention after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85 °C.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking experiments, controls and observations to mechanisms.
Adapt OpenPerov using structured evidence; refine selected responses with retrieved evidence in OpenPerov Pro.
Evaluate scientific reasoning with PSM-Bench and experimentally test a recommended self-assembled monolayer contact.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted OpenPerov Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: The reported device validation concerns one contact-design test, and dark thermal ageing does not establish long-term operational stability under illumination.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
